summary: expect options: chdir, the required command, creates/removes guards, echo, the required responses map of regex to answers (list for successive prompts), and timeout (null disables).
questions: How do I give different answers to the same prompt appearing several times?
How do I skip an expect task if a file already exists?
How do I disable the timeout on expect?
What is the default expect timeout?

answer_card.title: expect parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `command` (required)
- `responses` (required): dict of **regex → answer**; string repeats for every match, list gives successive answers
- `timeout` (30s; `null` disables)
- `creates` / `removes`: skip if file exists / doesn't exist
- `chdir`, `echo` (false)
